name: Xiamen Hongxin Electronics Technology Group Inc.
summary: Xiamen Hongxin Electronics Technology Group Inc. engages in the research, design, development, manufacture, and sale of flexible printed circuit board products in China. The company also offers AI computing power servers and AI computing power resource services. In addition, it is involved in the AI computing power leasing business and the export of its products. Xiamen Hongxin Electronics Technology Group Inc. was founded in 2003 and is based in Xiamen, China.
